title: Decision Table: Limits Re-Certification Charge on Policy-Number Amendments (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
On a policy-number amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the limits re-certification charge compares two limits of the bound replacement Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's package with the same two limits of the certified policy's package: the bodily injury per person limit and the property damage limit.

| Bodily injury per person limit differs | Property damage limit differs | Limits re-certification charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 4.00 |
| Yes | No | 2.00 |
| No | Yes | 2.00 |
| No | No | None |
| No bound replacement policy on record | — | None |

Only these two limits are compared; a difference in the bodily injury per accident limit or in any other coverage does not count.

**Hypothetical comparisons.**
- Certified package 50000 per person / 25000 property damage; replacement package 100000 / 50000: both differ, 4.00.
- Certified 50000 / 25000; replacement 50000 / 50000: one differs, 2.00.
- Same limits on both packages: none.
